A ball of mass 0.25kg hits a wall at a speed of 16m/s. It then rebounds back along its original
path at a speed of 12m/s.
What is the impulse experienced by the ball during its impact with the wall?
A
1.0Ns
B
3.0Ns
C
4.0Ns
D
7.0Ns
